metadata.title: Data4Moz Super Intelligent Health Dataset — ADM3 Administrative Posts
metadata.description: GIS-linked health intelligence at Mozambique administrative post level (~405 units) with 20 novel composite health variables disaggregated from province-level sources. Coordinates represent approximate centroids (WGS84). Produced by Data4Moz Intelligence Engine.
metadata.coordinate_note: Approximate centroids based on INE 2017 census geographic knowledge. Not for cadastral use.
